_method: Hand-labelled by a human reviewer looking at every one of the 47 files at full resolution. Deliberately NOT produced by any model in this pipeline - grading a pipeline with its own output is circular and would make the accuracy numbers meaningless.

_fields.expect: Correct pipeline behaviour: 'extract' means a structured record must be produced; 'refuse' means producing one would be a hallucination.
_fields.duplicate_of: Set when this file is a re-send of another. Refusing it is correct; extracting it is merely wasteful, not wrong.
